sources.quote: The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts

findings.why: The meeting relied on the old Aurelia manual (rev 3), where a coating change needed notification only. Rev 4 replaces it. Under rev 4, a coating change needs written Aurelia approval (PPAP resubmission) before shipping. Rev 4 also requires notification at least 90 days before implementation. The switch of BK-330 to zinc flake therefore needs written approval first. Nothing in force covers it. The zinc flake coating (COAT-ZNFLAKE) contains only zinc, so no restricted-substance finding applies.
